issues.title: README vs operating picture — public_claim warning
issues.audit_claim: README claims release-candidate readiness but operating_picture shows public_release_ready=false
issues.detail: The README section heading 'Release Candidate Status' could be misinterpreted, but the body text explicitly says 'Rig Relay is in alpha (v0.1.0a1). The release-candidate gate is HOLD.' This aligns with operating_picture fields: public_release_ready=false, permission_mode=development_debug. There is no factual discrepancy.
issues.remediation_suggestion: Rename README section heading from 'Release Candidate Status' to 'Development Status' or 'Project Maturity' to eliminate the heading/content tension. No body-text changes needed.

issues.title: README feature list — implicit production-readiness signals
issues.audit_claim: README features section lists production-grade capabilities without qualification
issues.detail: The Features section (lines 128-144) lists 15 features in present-tense declarative form. While many are implemented, some are in dev-debug/alpha state (e.g., Live Mutation Readiness with HMAC-SHA256 is permission_mode=development_debug; Enterprise Attestation+RBAC is likely partial). The alpha/HOLD caveat in the Release Candidate Status section is not visually adjacent to the feature list, creating a latent expectation of production readiness.
issues.remediation_suggestion: Add a maturity annotation to the Features bullet list. Three options: (A) add '(alpha)' / '(dev)' tags inline to each bullet, (B) add a one-line preamble above the list stating all features are alpha-grade, (C) add a footnote. Recommend option (B) — lowest maintenance cost, clearest signal. Do not remove feature bullets; the features exist in code.

issues.title: github_carte_blanche_surface_report — audit claims empty/null placeholder

issues.detail: The file at docs/json/governance/github_carte_blanche_surface_report_v1.v1.json is NOT empty or null. issues.title: 266 docs with prototype/planning language — large prototype surface
issues.audit_claim: 266 docs contain planned/proposal/pending/future/stub/mock language indicating large prototype/incomplete surface
issues.detail: A content scan found 249 files in docs/json/ matching prototype-keyword patterns (planned, proposal, pending, future, stub, mock, placeholder, TBD, not yet, roadmap, phase, research). This is consistent with the audit's 266 estimate. The files represent both: (a) legitimate governance/planning artifacts (roadmaps, risk registers, research reports, phase plans), and (b) potentially stale or never-completed artifacts that should be triaged.
issues.remediation_suggestion: Do not enumerate all 266 individually. Perform a cluster-level triage using the categories below. Each cluster should produce a mini-inventory JSONL in docs/json/audits/prototype-triage/ recording per-file decisions: keep_as_planning, keep_as_roadmap, keep_as_research, merge_into_canonical, archive, or mark_as_stale.
